- (3 May 2023 - 31 May 2023) Calvin shared with Dave that he recently toured with Frank Ocean in Tokyo, describing the experience as exhilarating and the crowd's energy as incredible. Dave congratulated Calvin and mentioned his own recent work fixing a neighbor's car, expressing how therapeutic he finds it. They both reflected on the satisfaction and sense of achievement they get from their respective passions, with Calvin looking forward to performing in Boston next.
- (31 May 2023 - 7 July 2023) Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and looked forward to hearing about it. Calvin shared his excitement about his album progress and mentioned a car accident he had, but he was relieved that no one was hurt and the repairs were sorted out. Dave updated Calvin on his new rock band and regular park walks with friends, while Calvin expressed enthusiasm for both their activities.
- (2 September 2023 - 22 September 2023) Calvin and Dave discussed Calvin's recent album release, which has been well-received and motivating for him. Calvin shared his excitement about an upcoming tour and plans to explore and grow his brand. Dave expressed his support and shared his own experiences with music and car projects, while both reflected on their passions and memories.
- (19 October 2023 - 25 October 2023) Calvin thanked Dave for his encouragement and shared that the tour with Frank Ocean has been incredible but challenging to balance with personal life. Dave asked about Calvin's strategies for managing everything, and Calvin mentioned the importance of a strong support system. They both expressed their love for music and cars, highlighting how attention to detail is crucial in both fields.
- (25 October 2023 - 2 November 2023) Calvin congratulated Dave on becoming an engineer and shared his excitement about performing music with someone he admires, expressing how fulfilling it is. Dave praised Calvin's performance and shared his own joy in photography and a car restoration project. They both encouraged each other to pursue their passions and expressed excitement about their creative journeys.
- (2 November 2023 - 17 November 2023) Dave shared that he created a logo for his rock band and expressed his excitement about it. Calvin complimented the logo and discussed his music studio setup, emphasizing the importance of music in their lives. They both reflected on the significance of support and encouragement in their artistic journeys, with Calvin mentioning his efforts to support young musicians.

They both encouraged each other to pursue their dreams and stay motivated in their respective passions.
- (7 July 2023 - 3 August 2023) Dave and Calvin discussed their recent experiences and passions. Dave shared about a refreshing road trip he took, while Calvin talked about transforming a Japanese mansion into a recording studio and his excitement for music collaborations. They both expressed their motivations and support for each other's pursuits.
- (3 August 2023 - 22 August 2023) Calvin shared his plans to expand his music brand globally and expressed excitement about working with various artists. Dave congratulated Calvin and shared his own news about being selected for a car mod workshop, which he described as a dream come true. They both encouraged each other, with Calvin appreciating Dave's support and Dave expressing enthusiasm for his car restoration project.
- (22 September 2023 - 15 October 2023) Dave expressed excitement about a jam session with Calvin, emphasizing the fun and memories they would create together. Calvin shared his enthusiasm and mentioned meeting inspiring artists in Boston, looking forward to collaborating with them. They both discussed their passions—Dave with car restoration and Calvin with music—highlighting the satisfaction and motivation they derive from their respective pursuits.
- (19 October 2023 - 25 October 2023) Calvin thanked Dave for his encouragement and shared that the tour with Frank Ocean has been incredible but challenging to balance with personal life. Dave asked about Calvin's strategies for managing everything, and Calvin mentioned the importance of a strong support system. They both expressed their love for music and cars, highlighting how attention to detail is crucial in both fields.
- (25 October 2023 - 2 November 2023) Calvin congratulated Dave on becoming an engineer and shared his excitement about performing music with someone he admires, expressing how fulfilling it is. Dave praised Calvin's performance and shared his own joy in photography and a car restoration project. They both encouraged each other to pursue their passions and expressed excitement about their creative journeys.
